intent: Count catalogue product variants whose product kind is 'Workshop Drill Grinder and Sander' and return the count as a bare integer.
success_criteria: count equals number of rows in product_variants joined to product_kinds where product_kind_name = 'Workshop Drill Grinder and Sander'
answer message is the integer count only, matching format "%d"
refs cite the record_path of every counted product variant

args.stdin: SELECT product_kind_id, product_kind_name FROM product_kinds WHERE product_kind_name = :kind_name;
SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id WHERE pk.product_kind_name = :kind_name ORDER BY pv.product_sku;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
